proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1045 āgata arrived explicitly supplies Prakrit āya-/āa-, Nepali āyo and Hindi āyā, and the l-extension Bengali āila and Old Maithili ayalahũ. The selected āy-/āil- finite survey responses match this past-stem family even where the elicitation is glossed simply come. Regional l-endings, vowels and glides are retained without claiming an exact tense analysis for every spelling; no present-stem ancestry is substituted. Exact response: aila.
